intent: Simplify basic-card backgrounds and preserve clear subject silhouettes at small play sizes.

attack.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: one vertical 2:3 full-bleed raster illustration for a BASIC card in Nightfall Duel, shown only 68px wide in play. Edit the supplied card painting into a much clearer, simpler version. Preserve its premium semi-realistic dark-fantasy painted realism, restrained antique-gold metal, deep ink-green palette, warm upper-left key light and cool teal rim light. The user specifically requests a strongly readable subject contour and radically simplified card background. Background must be only smooth smoky ink-green/charcoal value gradients with very faint soft atmosphere: REMOVE all castle architecture, windows, stonework, flames, moon, floor debris and detailed scenery. Keep realistic material and volume on the main subject, but simplify busy engraving into a few broad tasteful engraved bands. Strong figure-ground contrast, crisp exterior silhouette, quiet negative space. Main subject safe inside central 78% width and upper 82% height, with dark empty lower 12%; do not crop the defining silhouette. NO text, numbers, logo, border, UI, card frame, infographic, or flat vector/icon rendering. Opaque background. Generate one artwork only, not a sheet. Subject/composition: ATTACK. Replace the cluttered clash with ONE large, broad steel sword in a clear upward diagonal, antique-gold guard and one cropped dark leather-gloved hand at its lower end. Entire blade tip and guard clearly visible, with breathing space. Blade is the dominant simple bright shape; a restrained short warm slash glint communicates the strike. No second weapon, opponent or torso, no shower of particles. Sword plus glove fills approximately 75% height, central and readable as ATTACK at thumbnail size. Use the reference only to preserve the sword material/design language and painterly treatment; rebuild the cleaner composition.
